title: Create one vertical 3:4 natural photogra
prompt:
Create one vertical 3:4 natural photographic portrait of a distinct new fictional, clearly adult East Asian woman, age 21, sitting sideways among pale bedding and looking back over her shoulder. She has a petite, light adult frame, moderately narrow relaxed shoulders, a compact adult torso and naturally full covered curves. Keep natural adult head-to-shoulder proportions and believable anatomy. The picture is an intimate everyday portrait centered on her quiet face, long black hair and the gentle shoulder-to-back line. Do not turn her to a frontal pose or pull back into a full-body composition.

Fidelity to these twelve written relationships is the highest priority: (1) The close vertical frame runs from the crown to the upper hips, with the woman occupying most of it. (2) Her torso is seen in a three-quarter back and side view, while her head turns over the nearer shoulder toward the camera. (3) Long black hair falls freely over her back and along the far side of her face, with a loose slightly off-center curtain part, soft irregular waves and fine flyaways. (4) Her face is a softly elongated oval, with a gently rounded cheek plane, a tapered but rounded chin, dark almond-shaped eyes and softly full rosy lips. (5) Her eyes meet the camera calmly, the brows are relaxed, and her lips rest lightly together without a smile or pout. (6) The pale blush-pink cropped camisole has thin adjustable shoulder straps, a visible small strap slider, a nearly straight back edge and soft fitted fabric with horizontal folds. (7) The nearer arm hangs close to the body, then bends gently forward at the elbow; the hand is hidden by the body and bedding. (8) A small strip of lower back is visible between the cropped hem and a pale gathered elastic trouser waistband. (9) The adult shoulder and upper arm remain light, with a compact ribcage and natural soft covered side contour, never a broad heavy back. (10) The scene has a plain cool-neutral gray wall, dark brown pillows behind her waist, and pale blue-white bedding in the lower corners. (11) Directional daylight from image right and front makes the black hair gleam and creates a clear-edged shadow across part of the lower back. (12) Her hair, shoulder and returning gaze form one flowing visual route, preserving an unhurried everyday mood without jewelry, props or staged gestures.

Facial character and hair: Make an independent new adult individual with refined, restrained East Asian beauty-editorial styling. Use a somewhat longer soft oval face rather than a round doll face; gently curved cheeks, a smooth adult jaw transition and a small rounded chin. The brows are softly straight with slight natural arches. The moderately sized dark brown eyes have a clear almond outline and relaxed lids, with a direct, thoughtful gaze. Keep a modest smooth nose bridge and softly rounded tip, natural philtrum, a defined upper-lip curve and a slightly fuller lower lip in muted pink. Avoid deep artificial eye sockets, a sharply projecting tall nose, carved cheekbones, enlarged eyes, pointed chin or childlike proportions. Use delicate skin microtexture and very light makeup, with soft daylight blush and natural lip texture. The face must have adult structure and quiet confidence, not a babyish expression. The black hair has substantial but natural length and density, loose shiny strands across the back, a few curved curtain strands touching the cheeks and one finer strand near the forehead. It is not a polished salon wave, short bob, tied hairstyle or smooth helmet. Let a few flyaways catch the light.

Wardrobe and shape: Use a simple pale blush cotton-stretch cropped camisole with narrow matching straps. One visible strap crosses the near shoulder and runs to the back edge, with a tiny matching adjustment slider. The back edge is nearly horizontal; the front neckline is mostly out of view and must not be invented as a deep plunging cut. The opaque fabric conforms naturally to the torso and shows small horizontal tension folds from the seated twist. The hem ends above the waistband, exposing a modest lower-back strip. Pale gray-white casual trousers with an elastic gathered waistband are only partly visible at the lower edge. No lace redesign, elaborate corset, gown, decorative hardware or added jewelry. Preserve natural covered volume in the slight side view without increasing the chest or showing its front deliberately. Shoulder relaxation, the soft fitted fabric, torso rotation and directional light should reveal a gentle shoulder-back and waist transition. Do not inflate the ribcage or broaden the shoulder girdle to imply fullness, and do not over-narrow the shoulders or pinch the waist. Her build is petite but clearly adult, not excessively thin or juvenile.

Pose and camera: Her seat and lower body are supported by the bedding, with the torso turned away and the head returning naturally toward the camera. The near shoulder is lower than the turned face and stays relaxed. The nearer upper arm descends beside the torso; the elbow bends forward near the lower-right portion of the picture. Keep the hand naturally hidden instead of inventing fingers for display. The far arm is mostly occluded. Maintain plausible neck rotation, shoulder joints and arm length. The near shoulder is softly rounded, not square or muscular. Place the face in the upper part of the frame and let the long dark hair occupy a diagonal sweep down the image-left back. Use a close, slightly elevated portrait viewpoint and a natural perspective with no wide-angle stretching. Retain enough peripheral bedding and wall to explain the seated pose without making the room the subject. Keep the crown inside the frame with minimal breathing room; do not crop away the face or elbow to fit the ratio.

Light and setting: A plain light cool-gray wall fills the background. Dark chocolate-brown pillows sit behind the torso and separate the pale clothing from the bed. Pale blue-white bedding makes broad soft folded shapes at the bottom left and bottom right. Directional window-like daylight enters from the right/front, illuminating the cheek, shoulder and upper arm and making fine cool-neutral highlights along the black hair. Preserve stronger contrast and a distinct shadow crossing the lower back and bedding; avoid flat beauty fill. The skin is naturally luminous with a subtle warm undertone within otherwise neutral daylight, not cold chalk white or orange. The clothes remain a very pale blush, the wall gray and the hair deep black. Use the contrast between loose dark hair and the small lit shoulder to guide attention toward her calm returning gaze. No added window frame is necessary and no real location is implied.

Finish as a coherent native 3:4 photograph, without stretching or upscaling. Use subtle photographic grain, fine hair detail, gentle highlight rolloff and light editorial retouching that preserves small skin texture and adult facial contours. Keep secure opaque clothing coverage and a face-led, non-explicit composition. Check the neck turn, shoulder size, visible strap and slider, arm bend, fabric folds and bedding contacts. Do not add visible hands where occluded, front-facing chest detail, text, watermarks, borders, logos or interface elements.
